title: The Girl From The Farm — EN/ES/FR (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm female vocal 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Spanish French heritage resilience
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
She grew up watching seasons turn the red earth brown to green
The girl from the farm learned more than books could ever say or mean
Her hands knew soil before they knew a keyboard or a phone
The farm was not a place she left — it followed her back home

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La chica del campo creció viendo el tiempo pasar
[The girl from the farm grew up watching time pass]
Aprendió que la tierra guarda verdades sin par
[She learned that the earth holds unmatched truths]
Sus manos conocieron el barro antes que el mundo
[Her hands knew the clay before the world]
Llevó la granja en el alma, un amor profundo
[She carried the farm in her soul, a deep love]

[Chorus — English]
The girl from the farm
She carries the red dust in her veins
The girl from the farm
She thrives in sun and knows the rains
She left but the farm never left her
The land wrote her name in the clay

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La fille de la ferme a grandi dans les champs
[The girl from the farm grew up in the fields]
Elle a appris la terre avant les livres du temps
[She learned the earth before the books of time]
Elle est partie mais la ferme l'a suivie partout
[She left but the farm followed her everywhere]
La terre rouge de Zimbabwe dans ses genoux
[The red earth of Zimbabwe in her knees]

[Outro — All three languages]
The girl from the farm… La chica del campo… La fille de la ferme
The land never leaves — La tierra nunca se va — La terre ne part jamais
The gardens still growing
